title: Locality Gatekeeper: enforce private/VPC residency + retention with automated evidence
creator: Maya Patel
description: Goal: Build a lightweight 'Locality Gatekeeper' service that enforces data residency and retention policies at the request-routing and storage layers for Private (VPC/on-prem) customers, and produces machine-readable evidence bundles for audits. Scope includes policy enforcement for region-bound requests, retention TTL tagging for persisted artifacts, and an evidence generation API for compliance teams and customers. Out of scope for this ticket: HSM/KMS integrations (covered by ENG-18093), cross-account RBAC UI flows, and long-term archival tooling. Design constraints: must work with existing routing stack, add minimal latency (target <10ms median on decision path), and be deployable into customer private control planes.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Decision API returns deterministic locality decision for any request with <10ms P50 added latency in benchmark harness
2) Persisted artifacts (logs, KV cache checkpoints, generated responses flagged as retained) have retention TTL metadata attached and are automatically expired by retention worker
3) Evidence bundle endpoint returns signed JSON bundle containing: residency assertion, retention policy id, timestamped decision history for the request, and link to underlying storage object(s)
4) Automated tests cover positive/negative residency rules, TTL lifecycle, and evidence bundle schema validation
5) Demo run with a Private deployment showing regional constraint preventing cross-region write during simulated outage
6) Documentation (console + API) and runbook for on-call engineers completed
tasks: Design API contract for Locality Gatekeeper (decision + evidence endpoints)
Implement admission hook in routing layer to call gatekeeper synchronously for write operations
Add retention TTL tagging to storage service and implement expiry worker
Create evidence bundle generator and sign bundles using service key
Add unit/integration tests and a small load harness for latency regression tests
Instrument telemetry: decision latency, enforcement failures, evidence generation SLA
Write docs: API spec, deployment notes for Private, and compliance runbook
Prepare demo and coordinate with solutions engineering for customer trial

risks: Synchronous enforcement may increase tail latency under load; mitigated with local caching + bulk eviction
Evidence bundles may contain PII if we naively include request payload; must redact or include only references to stored objects
Key management for evidence signing requires coordination with security and customer-managed keys in Private mode
Automated expiry worker must be robust to clock skew across Private clusters — design requires monotonic sequence stamping
notes: Implementation will reuse existing routing policy DSL where possible and extend with a 'locality' predicate
We will provide a 'compliance mode' for Private installs which locks gatekeeper to strict enforcement and enables longer retention of decision logs for audits
Consider follow-up ticket for retention-reporting pipeline that glues evidence bundles into quarterly compliance reports
Coordinate with Solutions Eng to run a pilot with two customers in EU and APAC to validate region constraints under simulated datacenter outages
